name: pyANTI-FASc
description: Python implementation of ANTI-FASc (Automatic Numerical Tsunami Initial conditions: on-the-Fly rupture Areas and earthquake Scenarios) for the fast generation of large ensembles of stochastic slip distributions on complex non-planar fault geometries. The generated slip models can be used as initial conditions for tsunami simulations in Probabilistic Tsunami Hazard Assessment (PTHA) and real-time Probabilistic Tsunami Forecasting (PTF).
abstract: pyANTI-FASc generates ensembles of stochastic slip distributions on complex non-planar fault geometries for tsunami-related applications.
